CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_r7.subtask_dependencies_ready(p_root uuid, p_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select not exists (
  select 1 from unnest(p_ids) as ref(id)
  left join public.subtasks s on s.id=ref.id and s.task_id=p_root
  where s.status is distinct from 'completed'
 )
$function$
functions.name: subtask_dependencies_ready
guard_subtask_dependency_write

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.node_activated(p_root uuid, p_node uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.subtasks s join public.tasks t on t.id=s.task_id
  where s.id=p_node and t.id=p_root and t.deleted_at is null
    and t.status not in ('todo','pending_assignment')
    and (s.started_at is not null or s.status in ('in_progress','stuck','changes_requested','for_review','completed')));
$function$
functions.name: node_activated
